messages:
kate (eng-runtime): quick sync — we need to prioritize KV cache policy changes for the serving runtime. customers are hitting high p99s when mid-request evictions happen.
ajay (pm): do we have concrete customer asks or is this proactive? which customers?
lucy (eng-ml): both. acme and brightshop reported: long sequences + streaming responses -> eviction thrash. they repro with prefix caching disabled.
kate (eng-runtime): exact ask from ACME: guarantee no cache eviction during active request if key exists in local shard. they want a safepoint for in-flight generation.
kevin (sre): that's tricky for mem-bounded hosts. we can either pin per-request keys until completion or do opportunistic async eviction. pinning raises OOM risk.
ajay (pm): decision criteria: 1) p99 latency improvement >= 20% on affected workloads, 2) <= 10% increase in host memory footprint, 3) rollout path with canary + auto-fallback.
lucy (eng-ml): acceptance tests we need: deterministic reproduce script, perf run with 8 concurrent streams, and unit test for KV race where read happens at same time as eviction.
kate (eng-runtime): draft RFC in PR is at https://git/repo/rfcs/kv-policy. quick config sketch:
```yaml
kv_policy:
  eviction_mode: transactional  # options: transactional | eager | relaxed
  pin_inflight: true
  pin_ttl_ms: 5000
  memory_headroom_percent: 12
```
kevin (sre): ops concerns: pin_inflight=true will keep items until completion -> headroom must be configurable per fleet. also autopropagate to autoscaler so we don't get surprise OOMs.
ajay (pm): launch checklist items I want in RFC: clear rollback trigger (p95/p99 drift), perf dashboard panel, customer opt-in flag, compatibility matrix for quantized kernels.
lucy (eng-ml): kernel selection interaction: transactional mode will add more synchronous KV reads; some kernels (fused-attn) expect contiguous memory and may be impacted. add kernel compatibility matrix with perf delta.
kate (eng-runtime): edge cases to call out in RFC: partial KV hits, KV miss with large beam search, streaming aborts, and multi-tenant eviction fairness.
kevin (sre): propose gradual rollout: 1) internal canary on dev cluster, 2) opt-in customers on dedicated, 3) 10% hosted traffic, monitor; abort if error rate > 0.3% or p99 increases.
ajay (pm): timeline: ship RFC review next week, small prototype in 2 sprints, canary after that. is that realistic?
lucy (eng-ml): prototype can run in device-sim mode. I'll add regression tests.
kate (eng-runtime): action items: lucy write test harness (due Tue), kevin add autoscaler hook and headroom config (due Wed), ajay update RFC with acceptance criteria and customer list (due Mon).
deploy-bot: scheduled deployment job created: job/kv-policy-proto on dev at 2026-03-25T03:00:00Z
kate (eng-runtime): thanks — I'll merge the PR with the acceptance criteria section filled and tag @eng-ml @eng-sre for review.
kevin (sre): one more: add metric reverse-lookup for evicted_keys_per_request; urgently needed for alerting.
